about: Rows read from Table 1 and the claim sentences of arXiv:2603.14425 (CNN-MPS, T-MPS, and the ViT and factored-attention values it lists), Sec. III and Table IV of arXiv:2507.10705 (HFPS), and the abstract of arXiv:2607.00398 (HQT), arXiv HTML parsed locally. The factored-attention value -0.4976764(7) is the private communication arXiv:2503.10462 Sec. III quotes as ref. [48]. Spin energies: S.S per site x 4N; Hubbard: per site x N; a per-site variance is stored as a total (x N for fermions, x 16N for spins). Row notes cite this file by its earlier form, scripts/add_sweep_rows.mjs (git history).

verified.note: Abstract: "This zero-shot protocol yields an energy of E/N = -0.49782(3), statistically consistent with the variational state of the art". It is not consistent: it is 1.3e-4 BELOW the best variational energy (CNN-MPS -0.4976939(2)) and 1.05e-4 below the zero-variance extrapolated ground state -0.497715(9), i.e. below the ground state itself, which no variational energy can be. See the defect flag.

Instance identity confirmed by that comparison value; the number is independently quoted as the HFPS result by both arXiv:2604.25775 and arXiv:2510.26906. No error bar in Sec. III; Table IV of the same paper (raw data of Fig. 7, L x 4 PBC lattices, 1/8 doping, U = 8) gives -0.76413(3) and sigma^2/N_site = 0.031283, added 2026-09-15. Published as PNAS 123, e2535288123 (2026); read from the arXiv version, the journal version not compared.
